paragraphs: Meeting you was one of the greatest joys of my life! While putting together the photos and texts for this timeline, I realised once again how much I love spending my life with you. You are gorgeous, funny, smart, kind, an amazingly talented artist and, on top of it all, the best girlfriend I could ever wish for.

Thank you for being a part of my life and bringing so much joy and love to it. Know that I cherish with all my heart every moment we have shared, and I can't wait to experience the many more moments we will have together.
Thank you for always being understanding and being there for me. I promise I'll always be there for you, no matter what!
closing: Happy birthday, my love! Love you VMMMMMMMMV,
